About this Event

Join our watch list for updates for
Yoga Conference – San Francisco, CA
Main Conference May 13 - 16, 2026
Teacher Training Intensive – May 11-13 2027
Featuring: Noah Maze, Doug Keller, Desiree Rumbaugh, Christina Sell, Jeannie Manchester, Adam Ballenger, Saraswati Clere, Suzanne Zuber, Madhuri Martin, Denise Hatch, Judyth Hill, Benjamin Finnerty, Masumi Yoshida
Musicians: MC YOGI Benjy + Heather Wertheimer
Yoga Scholar: Carlos Pomeda
Join us in San Francisco for a transformative yoga gathering designed to support well-being, deepen self-awareness, and cultivate resilience in an ever-changing world. More than a conference, this experience is a journey of personal transformation, collective connection, and conscious living.
Led by a diverse faculty of visionary teachers and wellness practitioners, this immersive gathering weaves together the enduring teachings of yoga with contemporary tools for embodied, balanced living. Participants will explore a wide range of integrative practices—including asana, pranayama, meditation, philosophy, Yoga Nidra, Ayurveda, sound healing, yoga for recovery and nervous system support—to build a comprehensive tool-kit for life both on and off the mat.
Whether you’re a lifelong student or a seasoned teacher, this gathering offers a rare opportunity to pause, reflect, and reconnect—with your body, your breath, your community, and the Earth. In a world that moves fast, this is your invitation to slow down and remember what truly matters.
What You’ll Experience:
Dynamic workshops and classes for all levels, including movement, breathwork, therapeutic modalities, and restorative yogaThought-provoking sessions that integrate yoga with neuroscience, Ayurveda, and subtle body healingEvening programs featuring music concerts, sacred sound, and opportunities for deep connectionThis event is an invitation to:
